parameters.note: Buck Lake is a small high-elevation lake in the Lake Tahoe basin backcountry near Barker Pass / Ellis Peak (Placer Co.), reached by the Buck Lake Trail off the Ellis Peak Trail. It sits east of the Sierra crest above the Tahoe west shore; even if its outlet is a Lake Tahoe tributary, the special Lake Tahoe tributary closure (§7.50(b)(152)(A)) reaches flowing tributaries only 'upstream to the first lake' and does not extend into the lake itself. Buck Lake is not listed by name in §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so the general statewide lake regulation §5.85(a)(1) applies: open all year, 5/10.

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water)
